title: Testing of a Candy in Five Different Versions for the Additional Humidification of the Oral Cavity
brief_summary: This study is to investigate whether a candy can increase moisture of the oral cavity and reduce dryness of mouth.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* non- smoker
* no allergies
* no drug- use (except for contraception)
* healthy volunteers (no disease/infection 4 weeks before study participation)

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant women
